title: trachelospermum verrucosa
intro: Trachelospermum verrucosa, commonly known as the rough-leaved jasmine, is a type of climbing plant native to China and Southeast Asia. It has been used in traditional medicine for its therapeutic properties and offers various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. The bioactive constituents of Trachelospermum verrucosa include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as promoting relaxation and reducing stress. The plant's therapeutic actions include sedative, antispasmodic, and anti-anxiety effects, making it a potential natural remedy for anxiety and insomnia.
